FrySharp table.description: Show a list of records (or maps) as a sortable, filterable table

FrySharp line chart.description: Show numbers as a line chart

FrySharp bar chart.description: Show numbers as a bar chart

FrySharp maven package.description: Use a library from Maven Central: it is downloaded when the cell runs

FrySharp share from another language.description: Copy a variable of another language's kernel into this cell (a list of objects becomes a List of Maps)
